body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics displayed its third generation Blu-ray player ‘BD-P1400’ during KES 2007. Adopting 7.1-channel and Dolby Digital Plus, it features HDMI 1.3 av receiver and Samsung's Anynet+ technology enabling you to network your home via one remote controller.
